learning_outcomes.text: Express fundamental conservation laws in different forms.
Draw simple geometries in ANSYS environment for CFD, create numerical solution mesh, and define boundary conditions.
Perform flow visualization (post-processing) for simulated flow systems and interpret the results.

syllabus_topics: Review of mass, energy, and momentum equations for fluid flow
Internal and external flows, pipelines and networks, pump selection
Pressure, temperature, and flow rate measurement in fluid systems
Differential forms of governing equations for fluid flow
Introduction to turbulent flow and turbulence modeling
